sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Rosan Bosch Studio developed a comprehensive learning masterplan for a 60-acre campus with 70,000 sqm of interior learning spaces for KIS International School Reignwood Park, situated in Pathum Thani just outside Bangkok, Thailand. The project fosters a strong sense of belonging and offers imaginative, inspiring learning environments for age-specific communities of learners.
